data.body: [P2] Require reports from every matrix version before clearing warnings. Timing-report errors are swallowed and artifact uploads are conditional, so successful integration jobs do not guarantee both artifacts exist. If only the 22.x artifact arrives with a baseline and no outliers, `fullCheck` becomes true and an existing 24.x slowdown warning is replaced with “No test file is slower than usual,” despite having no comparison for 24.x. Require a comparable artifact for every configured matrix version before clearing, and cover the missing-version case.
